freeze: Constructor-fixed before execution; no independent preregistration or empirical rerun.
estimator: Weighted least squares with fixed design. Complex estimate = coefficient0+i*coefficient1; coefficient2 is local constant baseline. No full-record demeaning, padding, carrier refit, taper division or decimation.
valid_centers: 1024 through15159 inclusive, 14136 outputs. Real-time availability delayed1024 samples; timestamps refer to window centers.
synthetic_bank: Same six explicit generators as boundary benchmark v0.1; frozen source formulas copied into new standalone verifier. Add constant offset, bounded noise, constant phasor with arbitrary phase, and deliberately wrong carrier controls.
synthetic_gate: complex relative RMS <=1/100 and maximum phase error <=1/50 radians where true amplitude>=1/5 V; no empirical gate revision.
error_contract: For local model V[j+k]=Re(u[j+k]*exp(i*omega*(j+k)/fs))+b[j]+e[j+k], if |u[j+k]-u[j]|<=L[j]*|k|/fs and |e|<=epsilon[j], then |zhat[j]-u[j]*exp(i*omega*j/fs)| <= L[j]*sum|h[k]|*|k|/fs + epsilon[j]*sum|h[k]|. Unknown L/epsilon remain open.
empirical_status: No experimental data analyzed; 0/891 prior gate preserved. Gain, skew, source envelope regularity and full energy/native support uncalibrated.
